description: start, shutdown (clean ACPI), reboot, or stop (hard power-off). Returns an action to poll with get_action. Scope: vms.action.

type.description: start powers on; shutdown asks the system to stop cleanly (ACPI); reboot restarts; stop cuts the power at once, unsaved data may be lost.
